title: Minnow Mansion | KEY.co
description_expanded: Perched in the tranquil enclave of Seagrove Beach along Florida's scenic 30A, this charming vacation rental offers an extraordinary coastal experience. The home is meticulously designed to showcase panoramic views of the Gulf of Mexico, with vistas available from the living room, a novel tower addition, and various sitting areas dotting the dunes. Accommodating up to eight guests, the property includes three bedrooms and three bathrooms, spread between the main house and a private carriage house, each space echoing the serene environment with large windows and light, airy interiors. Particularly noteworthy is the tower, which has been thoughtfully crafted to provide covered seating that presents unobstructed views of the shimmering waters and rolling dunes, making it an ideal retreat for reading or a serene nap. Beyond the unique architectural features, the residence is enveloped by lush mature trees and the refreshing salty breeze of the Gulf, enhancing the sense of escape. The main house boasts a modern kitchen that faces out towards the dunes and sea, merging functionality with breathtaking views. Outdoor living is equally inviting with a beach deck equipped with seating and chaise lounges, perfect for family gatherings or simply soaking up the sun. For those seeking more privacy, the carriage house offers a secluded king-sized bed and its bathroom. This Old Seagrove Beach cottage is not just a place to stay; it is a haven designed for deep relaxation and making lasting memories by the sea.
